key_insight: Read-only SQL access to structured device records raised quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for standard passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale analysis of perovskite solar cells requires structured experimental data, not just retrieval of relevant text.
method: Computed 755 ground-truth answers from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmarked six retrieval architectures across 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Equipped an open 14B model with read-only SQL access on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical literature and 50.8% on prospective literature; zero-shot accuracy was 1.6–6.5%.
watch_item: Accuracy remained near 51% even with SQL access, so quantitative outputs still require validation.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
